title: View on your own
lead: Visit at a time that suits you, without waiting for the owner. You open the door with a code that works only around your booked time.

unavailable.title: Self-viewing is not offered here
unavailable.platform: Viewing a room on your own is not available yet. Book a time and the owner or their agent will show you the room.
unavailable.listing: This place has no self-viewing times right now. Book a time and the owner or their agent will show you the room.
unavailable.action: Book a viewing with the owner

offer.title: Prefer to view on your own?
offer.body: This place has times you can visit alone with a door code. Verify your identity and phone once.

identity.title: Verify your identity
identity.body: A licensed provider checks your ID card and a selfie. Only the result is kept.

phone.title: Confirm your phone
phone.body: The owner can reach you during the visit. We send a 6-digit code by SMS.

time.title: Pick a time
time.none: No self-viewing times in the next two weeks. Check again later or book a viewing with the owner.
time.window: Your door code works from {early} minutes before your time until {minutes} minutes after it.

terms.title: Visitor terms
terms.english: The terms are shown in English, as the landlord's platform publishes them.
terms.accept: I have read and accept the visitor terms (version {version})

termsChanged.title: The visitor terms have changed
termsChanged.body: Please read the new version and accept it again before booking.

book.requirementsChanged: Something is still missing before you can view on your own. Check the steps above.

hint.owner: The owner confirms your time. The door code then appears in your enquiry, never in a message.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: We send a 6-digit code by SMS
phone.wrong: Wrong code. {count, plural, =0 {Ask for a new one.} one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}

panel.waiting: The owner confirms your time first. Your door code then appears here shortly before your visit.

host.label: Shown by
host.body: Message them here if you are running late or cannot find the place.

panel.left: Thanks for visiting. The door code no longer works.

access.codeUntil: Works on the unit and building doors until {to}. Do not share it.
access.before: Your door code appears here from {from}.
access.showHint: Shown only when you tap, and only during your time. Each time is recorded for safety.
access.over: Your time is over. The door code no longer works.
access.enteredLock: The door was opened with your code at {time}
access.leave: I've left and closed the door
access.notYetTitle: The code is not available now

reported.title: Problem reported
reported.body: Sent at {time}. The owner has been alerted.

access.leaveBody: Check that the door is closed. The code stops working at once and cannot be used again.
access.reportBody: Tell the owner what is wrong — damage, a door that does not lock, someone inside. They are alerted at once.
access.reportPlaceholder: For example: the bathroom tap is leaking
